criteria.requirement: Add App.validate_routes() returning structured overlap/missing_view/view_signature diagnostics using actual url_map/view_functions without invoking views. Report identical rule/host/subdomain overlaps in non-HEAD/OPTIONS methods, missing runtime views and inspect.signature(...).bind mismatches for actual route/default arguments. Ignore build_only, preserve wrapped signatures, optional args/**kwargs/MethodView and skip uninspectable callables or signature claims when url-value preprocessors may alter arguments. Do not speculate about intersection of different converter patterns or change default route registration/dispatch; this is explicit API inspection, not an unimplemented CLI.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
